patches_modified.name: Brave AMOLED theme
patches_modified.description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). Raised surfaces — buttons, cards, sheets and the Material You container ladder — can take their own surface color instead of one flat black, so the UI keeps an elevation step like Material 3. Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+; leaving that force off keeps the Material You roles and low-lStar selectors untouched. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.

patches_added.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_added.description: Pinterest and the ad and tracking code inside it read an all-zero advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same answer Android gives after you delete your ad ID. A switch and Pause hand back the real ID.

patches_added.name: Hide save toasts
patches_added.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as "Saved to" your board or the suggestion to follow the pin's creator. The pin is still saved.

patches_added.name: Original-quality images
patches_added.description: Has Pinterest's image model pick the original image before its large size wherever Pinterest supplied one. Uses more data.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads, AppsFlyer tracking, Bugsnag crash reports and the recommendations Pinterest publishes to Google Engage. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. Firebase Analytics is disabled in the manifest and stays disabled until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads and AppsFlyer tracking. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. Firebase Analytics is disabled in the manifest and stays disabled until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Downloads a pin or selected visible grid pins using original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. The pin menu can also copy that media's link. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download pin to the pin menu for original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from the home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides Pinterest's ad-only panels. Google's ad SDK isn't started when Pinterest opens. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes promoted pins from the home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides Pinterest's ad-only panels. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds separate switches for the Create, Updates and Search navigation buttons. Home and Profile remain available.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds separate switches for the Create and Updates navigation buttons. Home, Search and Profile remain available.

patches_modified.name: Open links in your browser
patches_modified.description: Opens pin Visit links and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in keep their usual behavior. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens a pin's Visit link in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in keep their usual behavior. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_added.name: Block remote network policy
patches_added.description: Blocks remote and cached network policies that add TLS trust anchors or override API and static-content hosts.

patches_modified.name: Disable Kaspersky background scan
patches_modified.description: Disables periodic Kaspersky scheduling and reports disabled workers as successfully completed.

patches_modified.name: Disable advertisements
patches_modified.description: Removes ad providers, sanitizes ad identifiers, returns an empty ad list, and keeps advertising consent disabled.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics and trackers
patches_modified.description: Disables audited analytics transports and replaces the stable request device identifier.

patches_modified.name: Disable background hooks
patches_modified.description: Disables audited boot, network-state, VPN, and Connect session hooks.

patches_modified.name: Disable invasive permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes privileged install, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor data access while preserving user-driven installs.

patches_modified.name: Disable push services
patches_modified.description: Disables RuStore and VK push initialization, services, and audited push receivers.

patches_modified.name: Disable verification hooks
patches_modified.description: Disables audited SMS, call, phone-state, SID, and Mail.ru verification hooks.

patches_modified.name: Exclude Google Play apps from update checks
patches_modified.description: Excludes only apps whose recorded Android installer is Google Play from update requests.

patches_modified.name: Hide gaming profile
patches_modified.description: Removes the gaming profile permission, hides the gaming profile widget, and blocks navigation to the gaming profile.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the gaming profile permission, hides both gaming buttons, and blocks navigation to the gaming profile.

patches_modified.name: Replace RuStore SDK device identifier
patches_modified.description: Replaces the RuStore SDK device identifier sent with payment and session requests with the zero UUID.

patches_modified.name: Replace VK SDK device identifier
patches_modified.description: Replaces the VK SDK device fingerprint sent by VK ID and VK Pay request paths with the zero UUID.

patches_modified.name: Restore secure-session compatibility
patches_modified.description: Adapts secure-session requests to RuStore 1.108 API changes for re-signed APKs.

patches_modified.name: Restrict background work to updates
patches_modified.description: Keeps only the workers required for automatic updates and allows update checks to run while RuStore is foreground or background.

patches_modified.name: Skip update authentication
patches_modified.description: Skips the update authentication suggestion and returns a valid completed result.
